rubric_items.reason: The code has CO-1, CO-2, CO-4, CO-6 and CO-7 as designed. Inactive gives null, one occupyingBetween query covers the range and slotStates is shared. The tests the design and threat model ask for (T-1, T-4, T-6, T-7) are now present.
Rules stay in DoctorService and the helpers come from lib/time and lib/slots. No logging and no routes are added. Both DoctorDetail types are updated together, and the web fixture is typed.
Six files change (171 lines added, 11 deleted), and every one is needed. The schedule() refactor is only the slotStates extraction the design asked for.

The code handles its edges: Inactive gives null, a day with no slots gives null counts, and validDay checks strictly. No web test covers the section or ?date= handling, and the URL sync misses one case.
The summary matches the diff for each file and for the tests that were added. It cites threat items (T-1, T-4, T-6, T-7), but threat.md is still missing from its inputs.

findings.text: This is the previous F-2, still open. No web test renders the Next 7 days section, the 'Not available' row or the row links, or exercises validDay/?date=. The only fixture sets nextSevenDays to null, so no test runs the new UI path.
